name: nk-work-kit
description: Everyday work toolkit for BUU Faculty of Engineering: draft Thai official documents — บันทึกข้อความภายใน (internal memo) and หนังสือภายนอก (external letter) — from OTT templates to ODT/PDF; request, list or cancel document numbers in ระบบขอเลขเอกสารอัตโนมัติ; upload finished documents to BUU e-Signature; check what is still pending in eDoc and e-Signature; fetch, ลงรับ and summarise new eDoc documents with the important ones flagged; transcribe meeting audio (Thai/English/mixed) to Markdown via OpenRouter; and track ongoing projects in an Obsidian vault with a generated dashboard an optional email digest of upcoming and overdue items, and an optional scan of Gmail and Calendar that adds new tasks to the matching project.
